**v1.12.1: the bot notices when it's knocked out and stops after 3 at the same goal, logs in by itself again, stops buying potions it already has, and gets past several places it used to stand still.**

All 18 fixes come from the live bot's logs on 2026-11-13 and 14. The whole set has been running on the test PC since the evening of 2026-11-14.

- **Fixed: knockouts were never noticed.**
  - **What was wrong:** the bot only looked for a log line the game doesn't write on a knockout. All 41 knockouts since 2026-11-07 went unseen: the dashboard's Deaths stayed 0, the battle recorder saved them as "unknown", and the puzzle learner took lost fights for won.
  - **Now:** a knockout is read from the game's match result. debug.log says "Defeated:", and battles and puzzles are recorded as lost.
- **New: stop after 3 knockouts at the same quest goal.**
  - The 3rd knockout at one goal within 3 hours stops walking and shows "Knocked out again and again" (also sent to Discord if alerts are set up). Each one used to be followed by a potion run of 5,400-7,200 gold.
  - **What to do:** use a stronger deck, bring a party or pick another quest, then press F8 to walk on. F8 starts that goal's count again.
  - The counts are kept in `learned\knockouts.txt`, so restarting the bot doesn't reset them. Knockouts while the bot is off (F6) aren't counted.
- **Fixed: logging in at the game's login box.**
  - The Account and Password fields are found from the game's memory instead of guessed from the screen. The bot clicks into the Password box instead of sending Tab, which the game ignored.
  - The typed test letters are read back at 2x and 1x, where Windows can read them.
  - If Enter doesn't reach the login server within 8 s, the login box's OK button is clicked (twice at most).
  - "Invalid username or password" after a RECONNECT (the session ran out) is answered by logging in again with your saved login. On 2026-11-13 the bot sat on that box for 7 hours.
  - A login box found when the bot starts is filled in only after the PC has been idle for a minute, never while you're using the game.
- **Potions:**
  - **No more runs for potions you have:** the game's own potion count is read. If a drink doesn't take, Ctrl+O is pressed again instead of walking to the shop.
  - **Ctrl+O is held from the first press:** the game missed the short tap 6 times in 6.
  - **Home / End during an NPC's talk:** the game refuses them then. The bot now presses Space through the talk and tries the key once more.
  - **Back out of the Commons:** after the Ravenwood gate the wizard no longer backs up through the gate it just came through.
  - **The shop's close button is found from the game's memory.** It was missed by 31 px, leaving the shop open.
  - **Fixed after the 2026-11-12 patch: sellers and items found again.** Zone placements read 0 in every zone, so potion runs found no seller in the Commons.
- **Walking and quests:**
  - **The Spiral Map's Go To World button** is clicked from the game's memory. The bot once pressed Space at the map for four hours.
  - **Zone changes on the same server** (some sigils) are now seen. The bot used to think the loading screen was still up and stood still for 30 minutes.
  - **Misread prompts:** a use goal's prompt ("Press X to Collect") and a talk goal's NPC are recognised even when the screen reader garbles the name. This only applies with the thing or NPC close by in the game's memory, and never for a Crowns, teleport or shop prompt.
  - **X at the quest's prompt while waiting at a goal:** if the first X wasn't taken, a prompt the quest wants gets another X, at most twice a goal.
  - **Keys are held for 80 ms:** the game reads keys once a frame and missed bare taps.
  - **Puzzles:** NPCs are only walked to when they're close and on the same floor. Two NPCs 5,000+ away had been tried for a blocked Icy Wall.
- **Battles:**
  - **Fixed: target clicks next to the Crown buttons.** At 1920x1080 enemy 1's name plate sits in the corner the bot never clicks, so the hit stayed picked, the round ran out and the wizard was knocked out. The Crown buttons are now read from the game's memory: the click is placed clear of them, and the bot targets another enemy if it can't be.
  - **A battle under another window:** with "Bring Wizard101 to the front" on, a round up in the game's log brings the game forward once you've left the keyboard and mouse alone for 3 s.
  - **Less pause after a Hydra (or any hit) is clicked,** and the card boxes from the game's memory are trusted more often, so fewer looks fall back to pictures.
- **Checked:** the five release scripts load, and 872 of 873 vision tests pass (`test_ahk_names`' speedhack path test errors, as on v1.12.0).
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to every install. Your settings, learned cards, routes and knockout counts are kept. A copy run from the code: git pull.
